node.statement: Let V=(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X. By the two displayed amplification definitions in node 1.2.3.1 and finite additivity of the sesquilinear form in its second variable, <Y,V>_n = sum_i <Y_i,V_i> = sum_i <Y_i,sum_j Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_ij)(X_j)> = sum_{i,j}<Y_i,Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_ij)(X_j)>. Thus the disputed third sum is exactly <Y,(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X>_n.
